slice.fixture: Synthetic role-local single mutable pointer. Trusted predecessor A0 had visible token v1 and immutable anchor sha:A0. A delete advanced the visible token, then a logically new recreation B0 intentionally reused visible token v1 but had immutable anchor sha:B0. A stale writer prepared from A0 then attempted an append.
slice.falsification: Plain version-token-only CAS is not sufficient under tested ABA/version reuse: the stale writer's expected v1 matches recreated B0's reused v1 and stale lineage is accepted. Adding an immutable predecessor/content-anchor identity to the compare condition rejects the stale write because sha:B0 != sha:A0.
